description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply -  Order to acquire the Lands in D/S Division, Ja-ela, Katana & Wariyapola for Water Projects
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains three separate orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific immovable properties (land parcels) for water supply infrastructure projects. Each order includes detailed descriptions of the land parcels, their boundaries, extents, locations, and the names of claimants. While a minister is named (Rauff Hakeem), this is incidental to the core purpose of the document, which is land acquisition for public projects. The content fits squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land acquisitions and property descriptions.
